_comment: The default, and the one to compare the others against: a world put together to come out like this one. Seventy-one percent sea gives twenty-nine percent land, which is Earth's share to a tenth of a point, measured over five seeds at every size; the crust left to break itself up by area gives a handful of masses with one big one, which is the shape of a world with an Afro-Eurasia in it rather than one continent or a field of gravel.
name: earthlike
label: Like this world
note: Seven tenths water, a few land masses with one much the largest, worn ranges and rain enough for forests. As near to Earth as these dials go.

_comment: What kind of world to play in. These are the dials of the generator with names on them: the pieces the crust is broken into, how long the weather has worked on it, how much of it is sea and how wet it is. Everything else follows - where the ranges run, where the rain falls, which countries exist and therefore where anybody can live. "size" is small, medium, large or huge (64, 96, 128 or 192 cells - 35 to 104 km across), or "cells" for a number the interface does not offer; it is where the size dial starts rather than a fixture, and a preset that names neither starts at medium. Measured across three seeds, every preset holds its character at every size: the land share, the river density, the number of countries and the number of communities are the same to within a point. So the size is a matter of how far you want to walk, not of whether the world comes out right.
name: fertile_crescent
label: Fertile Crescent
note: One continent, old worn ranges, a long river to a delta. The country this game's content was written for.

name: young_world
label: Young world
note: The rock as the plates left it: sharp ranges, deep trenches, nothing weathered down yet. Hard country and a lot of stone.

name: archipelago
label: Archipelago
note: Crust broken into many small pieces under a high sea: islands, straits and long coasts. Fishers and boats, if there were boats.

name: pangaea
label: One land
note: Few plates and a low sea: one great continent with a dry heart, because rain does not reach the middle of a land that size.

name: green_world
label: Green world
note: Warm and wet, worn smooth: forest to the horizon, rivers everywhere, and the deserts pushed to the rain shadows.

name: dry_world
label: Dry world
note: Little rain and a low sea: steppe and desert, with life crowded onto the few rivers that cross it.
